hero.title: Tasheeh Academy
hero.slogan: We refine the idea, refine the vision — before refining a single letter.

about.title:
A specialised institution
for the Arabic letterform.
about.lead: Tasheeh launched in 2022 to establish the authentic methodology of Arabic calligraphy and pass it on, anywhere.

vision.title: Beyond the letter
vision.body: Posture, grip, visual memory, self-critique — the disciplines that make a calligrapher.

boundless.title: Borderless learning
boundless.body: Online, with direct supervision. Less travel, more practice.

mastery.title: From masters only
mastery.body: Internationally awarded teachers, certified ijazat, no compromises on craft.

methodology.title: Step-by-step learning, the <accent>Mashq</accent> way
methodology.highlight: Our method is built on repetition.
methodology.highlightSub: Progress to the next lesson is by mastery, not by repetition count.

mechanism.title: Pick <accent>your way</accent> to learn
mechanism.subtitle: Four tracks covering every level — from first stroke to mastery.

recorded.title: Recorded Correction
recorded.summary: The traditional Mashq system, long-term, with your dedicated master.
details: Four lessons per month — one per week.
Submit your lesson by email as a scan or photo.
Get your correction back as video + image on your private Drive.
Earn ijazah upon mastering your teacher's standard.

live.title: Live Online Correction
live.summary: One-on-one Zoom sessions with your teacher, long-term.
details: Weekly live Zoom session at a fixed slot.
Best for those needing immediate feedback on grip & posture.

intensive.title: Short Intensive Course
intensive.summary: Time-bound courses combining live teaching and video corrections.
details: Focused topics in a short window.
Fastest path before joining the long-term core programme.
Runs in batches with fixed dates.

foundation.title: Beginners' Foundation
foundation.summary: First steps: posture, grip, tools, the alphabet of scripts.
details: For students who never studied with a master before.

beforeAfter.title: Before correction <accent>and after</accent>
beforeAfter.subtitle: Real results from disciplined practice and weekly assignments.

reviews.title: <accent>Their words</accent> say it all
reviews.subtitle: Messages from our students worldwide — honest reflections after a serious journey.
